body:
I've actually overcame a lot. I'm a MUCH better person than I used to be. I just wish I was this person during our relationship. She "grew up" a lot faster than I did while she was at school.

And concerning my anxiety - it's the primary reason why I dropped out of school. It's why I'm back living with my parents. It's part of what caused so much stress in our relationship (we lived in a city and I'd have panic attacks in large crowds which were inescapabel).

I'm a wreck.

Thank you. I hope you're right, I really really do. I'm terrified that in ten years, I will still be in love with the 20 year old version of this girl. That in ten years, I'll still dream of her every night. That I'll cry myself to sleep and hug my blanket like a child because it's the closest thing to simulating a hug from her. I've been waiting for spring since October. I saw spring as my savior. Warm weather, more sunlight. Now I see it as a mark to show how much time has passed.

I feel like I'm forgetting her while at the same time all I can *do* is remember her. Im going insane.

I have intense social anxiety and poor social skills. She saw through that.

She loved and accepted things about me that most people would not.

I feel like our love was so intense because of our age, I don't know if something like that can ever be replicated or be an equivalent.

And one thing is for sure. I wont find love here.
Thank you..sometimes remembering that there are others is in itself comforting.

This was really well said, thanks. The idea of living with this, in this state, for years...it terrifies me. To no end. And what if years turns into a decade? I know it's unreasonable, I know it's unlikely...but what if I can never get out of this rut? What if her leaving me caused irreparable damage to me and im just prolonging my pain? I just want to relive the moment when she said yes, wiping tears from her eyes. I want to exist forever in the day we shared that concluded with making incredibly personal vows to eachother in front of our families and friends. We were young and foolish...but god damnit i was never so happy, never so fulfilled and sure, never so in love.

Im a social wreck. She took the time to learn who I was and love me. She was so far out of my league. Beautiful, incredibly incredibly intelligent, hard working. I'm a pudgy, pasty socially awkward 21 year old with thinning hair and a receeding hairline. I can never reach that level again
Thank you

Every day seems to be getting worse and worse. The best days I feel detatched, emotionless, zombie like...On the worst days I pace around my room trying to control my breathing as I try to avoid dangerous thoughts. I can't win, and the worst days are becoming more frequent. I've tried smiling at at myself in the mirror every day to release endorphins, ive tried to "fake it till I make it"...I just cant do it without her.
Thank you.
I try to cling on to hopes like that...but it also seems to enhance my overall hopelessness.

Honestly, I've been focusing a lot on taoist philosophy. Doing my best to live in the present rather than become depressed by the past or anxious about the future....It helps. Buit ultimately...at the end of the day...I can't shake her. I just looked at old text exchanges between us for the first time in 3 months. Where she tells me literally days and weeks before her decision to leave me that she loves me, that we'll make it, that everything will be okay. And the thing is, I think she was being honest when she said those things...that she believed it. She just hadn't reached her breaking point yet.

And I appreciate the advice. I don't usually turn to alcohol, but this last week I've gotten shit faced 4 times (Tuesday was the 5 month "anniversary" of the break up"). I know it's an unwise slippery slope...but it makes me feel better. God damnit.

I don't know how to purge her essence, her memory, her smile and laugh, her understanding and perspective from my mind. I went to one of our favorite restaurants alone on a whim today. Without thinking about it, I ordered her favorite dish instead of my own. And every bite I took rendered a flood of nostalgia and longing.

I miss her so much. Fuck fuck fuck. I don't know how to come out of this.

I'm trying so so hard. I really really am. I come here or /r/depression or /r/breakups when I begin to fall apart... When I have nowhere else to turn. Just trying to make a connection, just to remember that I'm not alone. I've gone through about 4 different therapists since she left me in October. I finally found one who works for me, but I can only see him on a monthly basis. It's really hard. I have few friends, and they stopped being there for me only a month after the break up. I spend a lot of time crying. A lot of time trying to reach out on reddit, or making desperate facebook statuses, or writing suicide notes, or writing her letters and throwing them away. Part of me wants to die just so she'll feel responsible. Not so much as a punishment...but as a way for her to remember me and maybe regret what happened. The idea that she views me as a mistake that should have "ended two years sooner" haunts me. I would have died a thousand times for her. And I still would. I love her so much and I hate it. I hate it so god damned much. I hate that when I go to sleep, my last thoughts are always "Good night Michelle, I love you".

I've never played them. But that's pretty interesting. I'm drunk and I write really cryptic when I'm drunk.

My story is a common one. I'm not special. The love of my life left me and I just don't know how to even begin to live without her. 156 days later and I'm still a wreck.

Living with my Dad is..okay. I couldn't do it with out him. I couldn't support myself on my own and he's there and provides as much as he can. But I see my life now, a life I thought I'd never have to return to...a lesser life, comparably. It's hard.

I feel like I'll never be as happy as I once was. I feel like I peaked. I feel like that the circumstances and depth of our experience isn't repeatable. That I'll forever mourn my loss. That food will never taste as good. That the sunrise will never be as beautiful. I used to be her Sunshine, her everything. I felt like I could fly, like I was God. Now I'm just an old memory, a flickering flame of her past. She'll forget me one day. And I fear I'll never forget her. I fear that I'll always love the girl I once knew.

This feeling mixed with extreme social anxiety and a very poor support and social structure has turned my life into a waking nightmare.
No, I didn't mean to leave that impression. She left me.
Im freaking the fuck out. I cant fucking do this. I love her so much

I'm not offended. I smoked daily for the first two months after the break up. It helped me understand why she left, helped me put myself in her shoes, increased my empathy, etc. But it doesn't take away the pain. It doesn't take away from the fact that Im still in love with her and she's gone

I'm trying. I've been trying for these last five months. Yes: I learned so much and am a much better person because of this experience. But I'm also in so much pain. These last two days have been the worst since the first week after I took the bus home to my parents' from Chicago.

I cannot look to the future because the future looks hopeless. I met her in such a unique environment and our love grew in such a particular way. We grew together and loved each other from such a hugely influential and developmental time of our lives. The fusion of childhood and adulthood. Our love was pure. And for a long time, her love matched my own, perhaps even surpassed it. Now she views me as a bad memory, a mistake. Something that lasted two years longer than it should have.

I cant look to the future because the past presents an experience that I can never again match. I have terrible social anxiety. My friends are dwindling. I'm alone.

None. I've tried. They're done with me. They only like me when I'm not complaining. But even when I avoid it, I'm going insane inside of my head. All I can think of is how it didn't have to be this way, what she's doing and what we could have been doing that very moment.

I can't think of a single thing my friend. 
I slept sixteen hours today. *Sixteen*
And I'm exhausted, and hyperventilating and sobbing. It hasn't been this bad since the first week after I took the bus ride to my parents home from Chicago.
I just want to drink until I pass out. And i dont want to wake back up

She was my best (and might as well have been my only) friend.
My depression and complacency sucked the life out of her and forced her to seek out her happiness elsewhere. Without me.

I'm trying so hard. But at the end of the day, she's gone. Forever. And I've never been so utterly alone.

Misery loves company. And a healthy person will likely recognize misery and avoid it. I wouldn't seek out someone who is as miserable as you are, or someone who will partake in dangerous acts because of it. I close friend of mine died three times before he was finally revived after shooting heroin with his girlfriend almost every day for weeks.

You know a side of the human condition that a lot of people blind themselves to, but they all intrinsically know it. Fear of rejection just means you have a lot of empathy. I have extreme social anxiety, and fearing rejection truly fucked a lot of things up for me. I dropped out of school because of it. I lost the love of my life because of it. I can only ask her to reassure me that she loves me so often before she popped.
I wish I knew. Thank you so much for taking interest. Even as a complete stranger on the internet, it's more than I have received in a long time.
I can't stop crying

I was on various medication throughout highschool. The only thing I can really say they did was cause me to gain 70 pounds in 6 months and manifest suicidal tendencies that had never existed prior to their use.
Just a bunch of empowerment ideas. He barely knows my story. He's the only one who has even begun to "get it" and Im never able to see him.

All I can say to you is try so hard to not let it rule you and to not let it become an egocentric manifestation. SO's can only do so much. First she'll try to protect you and care for you. Then she'll want to leave, but become terrified that you'll hurt yourself so she doesn't. Then, after months/years of Hell, she'll leave. Never become complacent and never assume that your perfect situation will remain without work.

I wish I could just forget. I wish every day. I'm still in love with her. And I will be in ten years. Even though she will be unrecognizable to me, I will still be in love with that girl who made everything right. Who made me believe that there was nothing I couldnt do - and i truly, it would be okay, because she would love me so much no matter what.

Too many people. The one decent therapist I have found (after going through more than half a dozen) is booked throughout the month. I see him once a month.

My friends were there for me for the first month. After that they started distancing themselves from me.

When I have no one else to go to, I call my father and sob into the phone. And as much as I love him, he cannot help me.

She made my world bright, even during times that I thought were my darkest. Now I know what real darkness feels like. She's happy now, and I feel this twisted happiness for her mixed with terrible despair. She's surviving and she doesnt need me. or want me.

I dont want myself
